Mentoring & training

Mentorship & Supervision

Students, postdoctoral fellows, and visiting researchers I have supervised and mentored, along with how to join our group.

On Mentorship & Group Culture

Joining the group & fellowships →

I consider mentorship and collaboration to be at the heart of much of my research and love working with students, postdocs, visiting researchers, and faculty across disciplines as part of the Astrostatistics Research Team (ART). If you are interested in working with me on a short-term or long-term project, please do not hesitate to reach out; details on fellowships, graduate admissions, and undergraduate research programs can be found under Working With Me & Opportunities on the home page.

Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion

For centuries, explicit and implicit discrimination have barred individuals from many backgrounds from participating fully and freely in science. As scientists and people, we have a duty to address these injustices to better both our profession and society at large. I endeavor to create a community in which all members feel that their diverse backgrounds can be an integral part of their identity as a scientist rather than something that excludes them from being a valued member of the scientific community.

Open and Accessible Science

I am a strong proponent of open, accessible, and reproducible science. When conducting research, my collaborators and I make an active effort to share our results along with public data products, interactive visualizations, and open-source code that remains public throughout its development and well-documented when released to the wider community.
